info.longName: J P Morgan Exchange-Traded Fund Trust - Sustainable Municipal Income Etf Fund

funds_data.description: The fund invests in a portfolio of municipal bonds, including municipal mortgage-backed and asset-backed securities. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in municipal bonds, the income from which is exempt from federal income tax. The fund also invests in municipal mortgage-backed and asset-backed securities, as well as restricted securities.
